title: Finite reductions of Verdier duality
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $1\le m\le n$ and let $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\to B=A_{E,m}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ be the quotient map. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the bounded constructible finite-Tor category $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], with the corresponding étale constructibility convention [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Put $K_B=K\otimes_A^LB$ using derived scalar extension on that site [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. On the étale site put $\omega_{X,A}=Ra_{X,A}^{\times}A$, where $a_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is the structure morphism, and $D_{X,A}K=R\mathcal Hom_A(K,\omega_{X,A})$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, lem-weil-duality-pairing]; define $\omega_{X,B}$ and $D_{X,B}$ similarly. On the finite-coefficient pro-étale constructible category use the dualizing object transported by the site comparison [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison]. On either finite coefficient site, for every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ there is a natural isomorphism
$$
d_{K,A,B}:(D_{X,A}K)\otimes_A^LB\xrightarrow{\sim}D_{X,B}(K_B).
$$
The maps form a cocycle under further coefficient quotients and carry evaluation and the double-dual morphism to the corresponding maps at $B$. If $\dim X\le d$ and $K$ has Tor interval $[a,b]$, both sides have Tor interval $[-b-2d,-a]$. Here Tor interval $[a,b]$ means that $\mathcal H^i(K\otimes_A^LN)=0$ for every $i\notin[a,b]$ and every sheaf $N$ of $A$-modules in degree zero, on the site under consideration.

proof.text: Apply lem-coef-finite-verdier-coefficient-diagrams and retain its pairings, tensorators, comparison transformations and evaluation, biduality, identity and cocycle laws on both sites. Its two dummy Tor predicates assert only True. The comparison requirements are the unchanged predicate of def-coef-finite-verdier-comparison-data.

For an etale input K in interval [a,b], apply verdier_preservation_strata to DK; finiteHomDomain_flatModel gives scalar extension of DK the same dual interval [-b-2d,-a]. Apply lem-coef-finite-verdier-proetale-left-tor for the analogous left endpoint on the other site.

The generic Lean lemma coherent_with_left_bounds retains the already supplied comparison diagrams and adjoins the left endpoint bound. Each comparison component is invertible; carry the left bound across its asIso to obtain the right endpoint bound. Etale Tor invariance maps this isomorphism through derived tensor and homology; pro-etale Tor invariance changes each representative isomorphism by composition with the inverse. Apply this lemma on each site and pair the results.
